title: Tunes and dances in Bolden's time
summary: Jones recalls Funky Butt, waltzes, mazurkas and quadrilles, knows nothing of slow drag, and cannot say whether Careless Love or Buckets Got a Hole in It were played.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Now Bolden, what tunes would he play? Do you remember any tunes he played?
Well, I'm one of them used to play. The funky button. Oh yeah. Yeah, that's one of them. Take it away, yeah.
Yeah.
But I done forgot the name of them, all of them. I used to know all of them.
Did you like to dance in those days yourself?
Yeah, but I never did dance.
You never did? You did. I never did either, but I thought you must have danced to these days. I just wondered if they played a lot of slow tunes or a lot of fast ones for dancing.

Well, the waltzing, the mazookas, and all like that. That's what he played for dancing. In Miami City, you hear the rag music that they danced, only when they had a quadrill. Late at night you're getting about ready to break up there. Quadrill. The zookas, the waltzing, all them kind of things. I can't call all the names of them right now.
Yeah, I wondered if the people dance a slow drag in Buddy Bolden's time.
Nobody, nobody know nothing about that. Okay. What? I don't know, nobody know nothing about that. Slow drag.
What?
I never heard of that time Buddy Bolden was living. Mm-hmm.
Well, I know. Did you ever hear Callous Love? Who? Callous Love. Love, oh, love, oh, Callous Love. You know that song? I don't remember. Make me a pallet on the floor?
Well, I heard that, but I've heard that all.
I wonder who played these different tunes.
All them kind of songs, Buddy Bolden playing rag. Ragtime.
Could you hum a little bit of it? Who? Could you hum a little bit or, you know, give us a tempo?
I don't know nothing about no singing.

Oh. I can't either. I just wondered if you could pat your foot at the, you know, about the time he played. No, I couldn't do it. You don't remember how fast he played or anything, you know? Just give us an idea.
Do you remember, did they play Buckets Got a Hole in It in those days?
I don't know whether Buddy Bolden was kind then or not. But I know that place used to be playing. Oh yeah. I just wondered how Buddy Bolden was kind or not. Buckets Got a Hole in it.
